claim_judgments.rationale: C0000 faithfully combines the subsection (b) lead-in with paragraph (1) and subparagraphs (A) through (D), accurately capturing the duty of the local educational agency to describe in its plan how it monitors student academic progress through each specified method.

C0001 accurately conveys the requirement under paragraph (2) for the plan to describe how the agency identifies and addresses teacher disparities for low-income and minority students as required under State plans.
C0002 accurately captures the requirement under paragraph (3) that the local educational agency plan describe how it carries out responsibilities under section 6311(d)(1) and (2).
C0003 accurately captures the requirement under paragraph (4) to describe the poverty criteria used to select school attendance areas under section 6313.
C0004 correctly conveys paragraph (5), including the general nature of programs under sections 6314 and 6315 and outside educational services for neglected or delinquent children.
C0005 fully reflects paragraph (6) regarding services for homeless children and youths, reserved funds under section 6313(c)(3)(A), and coordination with the McKinney-Vento Homeless Assistance Act.
C0006 accurately represents paragraph (7), describing the strategy the agency will use to implement parent and family engagement under section 6318.
C0007 accurately states paragraph (8), preserving the condition 'if applicable' and describing integration with early childhood education programs and transition plans.
C0008 correctly captures paragraph (9) regarding how teachers and school leaders in targeted assistance schools consult with stakeholders to identify eligible children most in need of services.

C0009 completely captures paragraph (10) and its subclauses (A) and (B), retaining the overall requirement for transition strategies and the permissive/if applicable modalities for coordination and access opportunities.
C0010 accurately conveys paragraph (11) regarding supporting efforts to reduce the overuse of exclusionary discipline practices and disaggregating by subgroups.

C0011 accurately captures paragraph (12) and its subclauses (A) and (B), preserving the governing condition 'if determined appropriate by the local educational agency' and all nested program elements.

C0012 accurately captures paragraph (13) and its subclauses (A) and (B), retaining the agency determination condition and both illustrative assistance options for gifted/talented students and school libraries.
